# Data protection impact assessment

## Processing described

The processing of support tickets for Example Ltd customers.

## Necessity and proportionality

The processing is necessary for support and proportionate: only name, email and ticket text are kept.

## Risks to individuals

The main risk to individuals is unwanted disclosure of ticket text; a second risk is wrong data being shown to an agent.

## Measures

Measures: encryption at rest, role based access and a yearly access review.

## Sign-off

Reviewed by the privacy lead of Example Ltd on 2026-01-15.
